card.name: "To" after adjunct, before lithium
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after "adjunct" in bipolar disorder dosing text, ahead of lithium or valproate. It also fires weakly on a space before a number or on "on" in trial and side-effect statements.

modes.label: Adjunct to lithium
modes.description: The word "to" following "adjunct" or "as an adjunct" before lithium, valproate or divalproex.
modes.example: Maintenance treatment of bipolar I disorder as an adjunct<< to>> lithium or valproate: Continue treatment

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A bare space before a trial duration or dose number in study descriptions.
modes.example: In two<< >>6-week placebo-controlled trials of adult patients
